title: State Women's Education Scholarship
description: Government scholarship for women pursuing higher education
eligibility_criteria: Female students, family income below ₹5 lakhs, minimum 60% marks
application_process: Apply online through state education portal. Required documents: Income certificate, marksheets, Aadhar card

title: Women's Education Fund
description: Interest-free loan program for women students
eligibility_criteria: Female students aged 18-30, enrolled in recognized institutions
application_process: Contact local branch, submit application form with required documents
